name: Periglacial-Strath
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs magnetic pole anomalies, stark under a black sky.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, uranium, silicon, iron and platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
